text:
elaine: FYI customer reported two things from the console audit viewer -> downloaded CSVs have missing fields (request_id + user_email) for some rows, and some users with the `auditor` role are getting a 403 on download. can we triage? attaching a redacted sample.

matt: looking now. quick question — are they using the new dedicated/private env or hosted? could be RBAC mapping difference.

carla: it's a hosted org (org-42). support saw 3 customers with the 403 today, all on `auditor` role that previously could only view in-console but we added an export permission last month.

jen: my hunch is schema mismatch. we bumped audit_event.schema_version in last week's deploy (v3 -> v4) to include `device_id` and an encrypted `kms_meta` blob. export pipeline still reads v3 fields for CSV columns.

ashok: that would explain missing `request_id`? not directly. KMS envelope changes could lead to truncated base64 in CSV if exporter does naive string cutting on large blobs.

matt: reproduced local CSV with a v4 event: some rows show `"<binary>"` placeholder and downstream CSV writer leaves empty cells. dev note: exporter uses `json_extract` on a jsonb column expecting keys present.

francis: on the 403: console checks `audit:download` scope but our RBAC mapping for builtin `auditor` role grants `audit:export` instead (naming drift). deploy from 2025-11 renamed scopes. so two separate bugs: schema + RBAC key mismatch.

elaine: ugh. OK. action items?

security-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-045 created (audits: csv missing fields + permission mismatch). Assigned: @matt @jen @ashok. Priority: P2.

devex-bot: UI note — export preview pagination loses cursor if there are >50 rows; customer may click "download full" and backend paginates but returns an incomplete cursor which the exporter ignores -> partial CSV.

jen: plan: add compatibility read path in exporter for schema v3/v4 (fallback to `payload->>request_id` and `payload->>user_email`), and sanitize KMS blobs before CSV (store as signed URL or hash).

ashok: for KMS: we should not include raw kms_meta in CSV. propose we replace with `kms_key_id` + `kms_ciphertext_sha256` fields. need to update schema migration docs and Console export contract.

matt: RBAC fix is small: map `auditor` -> `audit:download` in the role-binding translation table. I'll prepare a rollout patch and gate it behind a feature flag for 24h.

carla: communications: I'll draft a short customer note explaining: root cause (schema/RBAC drift), mitigation, ETA for fix, and that we will re-generate exports for impacted orgs if they want.

francis: tests: add unit test for exporter reading v3 & v4 payloads, integration test for pagination -> full-download with cursor, and e2e that verifies CSV contains request_id + user_email when present.

elaine: good. also add a post-delivery validation step — signed manifest file for exports (hash + record count) so customers can validate completeness.

jen: putting up PRs: #exporter-compat (fix + tests), #rbac-mapping (hotfix + ff). target rollout tomorrow morning (UTC) after smoke tests.

matt: tagging infra to watch KMS ops during rollout in case the sanitizer trips on unusual blobs. @ashok can you add KMS metrics alert for exporter failures?

ashok: on it. will add exporter.kms.sanitizer.errors > 1/min alert to dev-sre.

elaine: thanks all. carla, please send the customer an interim note that we're investigating and they can DM support for immediate file re-exports. I'll update INC-2026-045 with timeline.

carla: sending now :thumbsup:

matt: I'll link the sample CSV + repro steps in the incident. snippet I used to repro:
```
SELECT payload->>'request_id' as request_id,
       payload->>'user_email' as user_email,
       payload->>'kms_meta' as kms_meta
FROM audit_events
WHERE schema_version IN (3,4)
LIMIT 100;
```

elaine: nice. keep updates in-thread. closing out after patch + validation.
